<main class="content"><div class="content-inner database-detail mudra-dictionary-page">
<section class="mudra-intro"><p>This dictionary brings together 30 mudras and codified gestures used in Buddhist iconography across Asia. Each card carries an English title followed by the Sanskrit term and sinographs. Each entry then provides equivalents in Sanskrit, sinographs, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Chinese, French, and English, followed by meaning, gesture description, iconographic context, and an artwork example.</p><p class="mudra-method">Card images are cropped so the hand configuration can be read immediately. Inside each entry, a smaller reproduction of an artwork places the mudra back in its iconographic context. Regional and ritual variants are not presented as universal prescriptions.</p></section>
